title: Northlight Studio · Architecture and interiors photography
description: Northlight Studio photographs homes, hotels and workplaces for architects, interior designers and builders.

hero.text: Northlight Studio is a fictional studio used to show this template. Jane Doe and a small team photograph buildings and the rooms inside them for the architects, designers and builders who made them.

chapters.title: Homes, inside and out
chapters.text: New builds, renovations and single rooms, shot in the light the architect designed for.

chapters.title: Hotels, restaurants and bars
chapters.text: Lobbies, guest rooms and dining rooms, styled and shot before the doors open to guests.

chapters.title: Offices and studios
chapters.text: Open floors, meeting rooms and shared spaces that show how a workplace is used day to day.

items.title: Residential
items.text: Houses, apartments and remodels, from the street view to the details of a kitchen or stair.

items.title: Hospitality
items.text: Hotels, restaurants and cafes, with wide establishing shots and close details for menus and booking pages.

items.title: Workplaces
items.text: Offices, labs and co-working floors for design awards, leasing brochures and company sites.

steps.title: Walk the space
steps.text: A short visit or video call to agree the shot list and note where the light falls at each hour.

steps.title: Plan the day
steps.text: Shots are timed to the sun, and furniture, lamps and styling are set before the camera comes out.

steps.title: Shoot
steps.text: Tripod, tilt-shift lenses and bracketed frames, so verticals stay straight and windows keep their view.

steps.title: Edit and deliver
steps.text: Color-matched, retouched files in print and web sizes, with usage terms written down.

sections.title: Why the light comes first
paragraphs: A room looks different at nine in the morning and at four in the afternoon. Most of the work happens before the shutter: choosing the hour, opening or closing blinds, and deciding which lamps stay on.
The glass shapes on this page bend light the way a good window does. They are drawn live in your browser, so this demo needs no photos at all.

sections.title: Plan a shoot
sections.lede: Tell us about the space, the timing and where the photos will be used. Email is the easiest way to reach the studio.
